done.what: (1) Narrow desk, 1025–1060, list view: the toolbar no longer pushes the page kebab ⋮ (the way into Deleted / Archived) out of the frame. The search sits in a new slot that starts at 200 and grows back to its 280 when there is room, so it gives way first (235 at 1025 in Quotes, 255 in My Items). If that is still not enough, the tools wrap within their own group from the right. Grid view and every width from 1080 up are unchanged.

(1) Tablet, 768–1024, list view: the Column settings button moves into ⋮ (a 'Column settings' row above Deleted …; `foldColumns`, hidden in CSS as `.columnsTool`). The list-view bar is now exactly the grid-view bar: one row (REG-384), and 'My Items' reads in full at 768. The name also keeps max-content; any state that still does not fit (for example a long filter word on the pill at 768) drops the tools to the next line at the right instead of cutting the name. I rejected the plain wrap at tablet: at 768 it made the bar two rows, and the folded search collapsed it to one on opening. That is a 36px jump, and a tap on a folder row just after it was lost (measured: no navigation).

(2) The Deleted sheets for Tasks, T&Cs & Notes, Payments and Contracts templates now get restoreBlock and purgeRule, as Materials and Designs do. A Designer sees the rule in the row: 'Only Dane, an Owner or an Admin can restore this template or delete it for good'. Presets read 'Only an Owner or an Admin can restore this template or delete it for good'. Restore and Delete Forever are greyed with the reason (tooltip 'Only Dane, an Owner or an Admin can delete this template for good'), the row takes no tick, and Empty Trash counts only what the viewer may remove. When every row shares the rule it is said once above the table, in the plural. Contracts' keepReason is back to usage only. Its Deleted sheet's person column is now 'Updated by', because that loader's `author` is whoever saved it last.

(2) Server refusals now match the action. `nothingChangeable(rows, 'restore' | 'purge')` looks up the maker's name, and `templateTrashRefusal` gives 'Only Dane, an Owner or an Admin can restore this template' or '…can delete this template for good'. Several rows with one maker get '…these templates'. Mixed makers get 'Only a template’s author, an Owner or an Admin can restore it / delete it for good'. Presets get 'Only an Owner or an Admin …'. All four action files pass the action. Every check is unchanged (still templateChangeBlock / canDeleteTemplateForever).

(2) Presets' menu wording: templateChangeBlock now says 'Only an Owner or an Admin renames or deletes it' when created_by is null, instead of 'only its author'. Same check; only the words changed. This also reaches the rename / delete / move refusals for presets.

(2) Deleted sheet, Empty Trash tooltip: when rows are kept for different reasons (a preset beside Dane's split) it no longer claims 'Every deleted template is still in use'. It now says 'None of these templates can be deleted for good — each row says why'. A single shared rule is shown in the plural when there are several rows.

(3) Create Quote modal: new prop `defaultBlock` (= templateDefaultBlock(viewer)), passed from the lead's Quotes tab and Tools › Quotes. The tile ⋮ › Set as default is disabled for a Designer, with 'Only an Owner or an Admin sets the studio’s default' as its meta line. The default tile's row reads 'Already the default' as a meta line, where it used to be a native title. Styles are the gallery's .menuRow / .menuMeta.
